unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Yosef of Yampol perceives that a Torah scroll in Mezhirech lacks a verse, and this is later confirmed during the reading.

stories.start_quote: הה״ק ר׳ יוסף וצוללה״ה מיאמפאלא בנו
stories.summary_en: R. Yosef of Yampol, son of R. Yehiel Michel of Zloczow, came to Mezhirech and declared that a Torah scroll there lacked one verse; later, when his brother R. Moshe of Zvhil read from it with his son R. Yehiel Michel reciting the Targum, the error was found in Deuteronomy, a verse missing from 'zered' to 'zered'.

quotes: בא למעזריטש ואמר יש בכאן ספר תורה חסר פסוק א׳
tags.why: He knows of the hidden defect in the scroll without having examined it

quotes: ומצאו שם הטעות בפ' דברי' שהי׳ חסר מזרד עד זרד
tags.why: The later discovery confirms what the tzaddik said

quotes: לימים הי׳ שם אחיו הה״ק ר' משה מזיווהעל
ובנו הה״צ ר׳ יחיאל מיכל זצללה״ה מזיווהעל
tags.why: The tzaddik's brother and nephew take part in the confirmation

quotes: יש בכאן ספר תורה חסר פסוק א׳
tags.why: A Torah scroll missing a verse is ritually unfit
The perception happens during his visit to Mezhirech
The public Torah reading is the setting of the discovery
